intro_line: Montevideo: a calm riverside capital of old cafés and long ramblas.
intro: Montevideo rewards visitors with a walkable old town, a lively food scene and a breezy waterfront promenade. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: No metro or tram; buses are the only mass transit.
Get a free STM card at Abitab; cash fare is about UYU 36, card fares cheaper.
STM gives 2 buses in 1 hr for about UYU 29, or unlimited buses in 2 hr for about UYU 44.
Ride apps like Uber work and are often cheaper and safer than street taxis.
Taxis are metered; a 10-minute ride costs about UYU 100.
Driving is possible but parking is scarce and expensive; walking is easy in the centre.
Buquebus ferries link Ciudad Vieja with Buenos Aires and Colonia.

airports.name: Carrasco International / General C L Berisso Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, about 14 km east of the centre.

options.note: Buses every 10-20 min; pay the driver, get off early for Pocitos or Cordón.
Buy in the COT office or on board; check the bus heads west into the city.
Private airport taxis are pricey; agree the fare first.
Often cheaper than airport taxis; pick-up point may vary.
